_note: Shot writer phase 2, worked example (SHOTS.md → Phase 2). A fictional fitness band: K01 on Seedance uses every phase-2 field, K02 on H3 shows what the short prompt keeps (the trick and the fail lines). Put it in a job as tools/shots.json beside a casting.json that has the sheet "runner" and the location "bridge", with the band's photo at assets/band.jpg. Its negatives are still only proposed: show K01 lists them apart and keeps them out of the prompt until `shots.py confirm K01`.

band.anatomy: The band is a flat matte strap with a small square face of black glass and one side button.

K01.brief: Her morning run over the bridge, seen from the band's side of things. Keep it real.

key.frame: Wide-angle from a short arm on her left wrist: the band fills the lower-left of the frame, her hand at the bottom edge, the bridge deck and its railings running away behind it.

K01.scene: She runs across the bridge at dawn to make a green light, and the camera rides on her wrist the whole way.
K01.first: The band in the lower-left third, her hand at the bottom edge, the bridge running away behind.

lens.distance: about 30 cm from the band, on a short arm
lens.focus: deep focus from the band to the far end of the bridge

K01.light: Low cold morning sun from behind her left shoulder; long shadows across the deck.

trick.rule: The camera rides on her wrist beside the band, so the band stays put in the frame while the whole city swings round it.
so: The band holds the lower-left third of the frame in every frame.
Every swing of her arm shows as the street wheeling past behind the band.
We never see the camera, its arm or the strap from outside.

must: The band never moves within the frame: same place, same size, every frame.
Her hand stays at the bottom edge of the frame for the whole shot.
fail: the band slides, turns or changes size in the frame
the street stands still while her arm swings

dont: the lens flare in its top-right corner

K01.task: she keeps checking the time on the band between strides

acting.direction: she is trying to make the green light before it changes
acting.motive: she promised herself a personal best today
acting.obstacle: a delivery van pulls across the crossing
acting.tactic: she cuts round the back of the van without breaking stride

eyes.do: on the light ahead, then a flick down to the band
on the van's back bumper, judging the gap
back on the light, then the band

the band.frame: a sixth of the frame width
the band.body: as wide as two of her fingers
the band.hand: it wraps her wrist with a thumb's width to spare

negatives: the band drifts or turns within the frame
the camera films her from outside
the street holds still while her arm moves
a second band or a second runner appears

motion.camera: The camera is clamped to a short arm on her left wrist, beside the band, and rides every swing of her arm.

beats.do: She runs onto the bridge, arm swinging; the railings sweep past behind the band
A delivery van pulls across the crossing ahead; she cuts round its back without breaking stride
She glances at the band as the light ahead turns green

audio: her footsteps on the bridge deck

K02.brief: The band on the desk after the run.

key.frame: Straight down on a worn oak desk: the band lies face up at the centre, a coffee cup at the top edge of the frame.
key.light: Warm window light from the left.

K02.trick: Locked off straight down, the band lies still at the centre while the light and shadows travel across the desk.
fail: the band moves, turns or slides on the desk

the band.frame: a fifth of the frame width
the band.body: as long as her index finger
the band.hand: it would lie across her palm

beats: Window light sweeps across the desk as a cloud passes
The band's face lights up once with a soft glow
